page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated physical cores utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 752.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.88 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the instance bundles four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 123,935.69 and a top-tier bzip3 multi-threaded decompression rate of 575.13 GB/sec. Memory performance is also robust, with read-only large block bandwidth reaching 253.9 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 103.09 GB/sec. Single-core performance remains moderate, as shown by average ratings in stress-ng single-core and gzip compression tests.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and multiple Ampere GPUs offers a highly consolidated hardware profile for parallel processing tasks.

Given its hardware configuration and benchmark strengths, the ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is suited for GPU-accelerated workloads, parallel data processing, high-throughput web serving, and multi-threaded decompression tasks.
